section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study investigating the associations between positive body image, sexual liberalism, and unconventional sexual practices in U.S. adults. An online sample of 151 women and 164 men from the U.S. completed measures of sexual liberalism, attitudes toward unconventional sexual practices, and various indices of positive body image. The study found that higher body appreciation was associated with greater sexual liberalism, and higher body appreciation and body image flexibility were linked to more positive attitudes toward unconventional sexual practices in both women and men.
